## General

## 60.1

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (1) This Part applies to Technology and Construction Court claims (‘TCC claims’).

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (2) In this Part and Practice Direction 60 –

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (a) ‘TCC claim’ means a claim which –

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (i) satisfies the requirements of paragraph (3); and

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (ii) has been issued in or transferred into the specialist list for such claims;

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (b) ‘Technology and Construction Court’ means any court in which TCC claims are dealt with in accordance with this Part or Practice Direction 60; and

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (c) ‘TCC judge’ means any judge authorised to hear TCC claims.

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (3) A claim may be brought as a TCC claim if –

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (a) it involves issues or questions which are technically complex; or

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (b) a trial by a TCC judge is desirable.

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (Practice Direction 60 gives examples of types of claims which it may be appropriate to bring as TCC claims.)

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (4) TCC claims include all official referees’ business referred to in section 68(1)(a) of the Supreme Court Act 1981 1 .

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (5) TCC claims will be dealt with:

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (a) in a Technology and Construction Court; and

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (b) by a TCC judge, unless –

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (i) this Part or Practice Direction 60 permits otherwise, or

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.1] (ii) a TCC judge directs otherwise.

## Specialist list

## 60.2

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.2] (1) TCC claims form a specialist list.

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.2] (2) A judge will be appointed to be the judge in charge of the TCC specialist list.

## Application of the Civil Procedure Rules

## 60.3

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.3] These Rules and their practice directions apply to TCC claims unless this Part or a practice direction provides otherwise.

## Issuing a TCC claim

## 60.4

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.4] A TCC claim must be issued in –

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.4] (a) the High Court in London;

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.4] (b) a district registry of the High Court; or

[PART 60 – TECHNOLOGY AND CONSTRUCTION COURT CLAIMS > 60.4] (c) a County Court hearing centre specified in Practice Direction 60.

## Reply

## 60.5

# Part 15 (Defence and Reply) applies to TCC claims with the modification to rule 15.8 that the claimant must –

[Part 15 (Defence and Reply) applies to TCC claims with the modification to rule 15.8 that the claimant must –] (a) file any reply to a defence; and

[Part 15 (Defence and Reply) applies to TCC claims with the modification to rule 15.8 that the claimant must –] (b) serve it on all other parties;

[Part 15 (Defence and Reply) applies to TCC claims with the modification to rule 15.8 that the claimant must –] within 21 days after service of the defence.

## Case management

## 60.6

[Part 15 (Defence and Reply) applies to TCC claims with the modification to rule 15.8 that the claimant must – > 60.6] (1) All TCC claims are treated as being allocated to the multi-track and Part 26 does not apply.

[Part 15 (Defence and Reply) applies to TCC claims with the modification to rule 15.8 that the claimant must – > 60.6] (2) Part 29 and Practice Direction 29 apply to the case management of TCC claims, except where they are varied by or inconsistent with Practice Direction 60.

## Judgments and Orders

## 60.7

[Part 15 (Defence and Reply) applies to TCC claims with the modification to rule 15.8 that the claimant must – > 60.7] (1) Except for orders made by the court of its own initiative and unless the court otherwise orders, every judgment or order made in claims proceeding in the Technology and Construction Court will be drawn up by the parties, and rule 40.3 is modified accordingly.

[Part 15 (Defence and Reply) applies to TCC claims with the modification to rule 15.8 that the claimant must – > 60.7] (2) An application for a consent order must include a draft of the proposed order signed on behalf of all the parties to whom it relates.

[Part 15 (Defence and Reply) applies to TCC claims with the modification to rule 15.8 that the claimant must – > 60.7] (3) Rule 40.6 (consent judgments and orders) does not apply.
